intelligence.enrichment: Matter is composed of a large number of extremely small particles; even when a substance is finely powdered or dissolved, its particles can remain present though too small to see with ordinary observation. physical division or dissolving changes how the particles are distributed -> the same substance may no longer be visible as large pieces The learner explains that grinding chalk or dissolving sugar changes size, visibility, or distribution while the substance remains present as extremely small constituent particles. If no visible pieces of a substance remain, that substance has become nothing.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Particulate nature of matter. The student must decide: Decide whether breaking, grinding, or dissolving a substance shows that matter is made of extremely small particles rather than becoming nothing.
